items.name: Driftbloom
items.description: The parent of the driftseed that catches in the plains hedgerows. It has been growing an hour's climb outside the valley the whole time, and everyone who wondered where the seed came from was looking in the wrong direction.
source_conditions: spring and summer, when the switchback is passable
clear or windy, which above the cloud line is most days
the outer edge of the cut road

items.name: Coldiron Lichen
items.description: Grey-green crust on the exposed rock above the weather. It takes a decade to cover a hand's width and it is worth being careful about, which Brin has said out loud twice.
source_conditions: any season; nothing up here keeps a calendar
clear days only, above the cloud line
north-facing stone that never sees full sun

items.name: Rimeflower
items.description: A white flower that opens on bare high stone in the coldest weeks and closes again by the thaw. It has presumably been doing this every winter for as long as the pass has existed, unwatched.
source_conditions: deep winter only, on the high stone
clear or windy; it will not open in weather
seen by nobody at all until the pass was kept open
